headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 黒地にレギュラー寄りのサンセリフを非対称に配置し、赤い細線でつなぐ。大きな文字の間に、小さな動画とチャットの図を添える。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE sophisticated typographic Chrome extension store listing design. Landscape11:7 aspect ratio, target1760x1120. NOT a panorama, collage or style board.

Direction04: rigorous Swiss editorial typography on a pure near-black field. White normal-width neo-grotesk letterforms in REGULAR and MEDIUM weights, clean open counters, thoughtful optical kerning and generous leading. An elegant published design-object, not a loud bold headline poster. The letterforms and spacing are the hero. Absolutely no ultra-bold, chunky Arial, condensed font, extrusion, bevel, metal, glass, plastic, drop shadow, gradient, texture or dimensional material. Flat black/white with one precise coral-red hairline and a few tiny red framing strokes.

Layout: asymmetric Swiss grid. "YouTube" near upper left, clear regular type with approximately70px capital-letter height at1572px image width. "Fullscreen" on a distinct long horizontal baseline around the upper-middle, normal width with approximately100px cap-height. "Live Chat" positioned to the right on a LOWER baseline near the bottom, similarly generous and large. Do NOT stack all three words at the left. Align their optical edges to an invisible grid, keep abundant purposeful negative space. Use one thin red horizontal rule to connect the composition visually without touching letters.

A single understated abstract16:9 video frame lies in the central/lower area, rendered by extremely fine white boundary/corner strokes. A small red play triangle is inside its left part. A narrow chat pane of three short strokes is clearly OVERLAID INSIDE the right side of this SAME frame, inset on every side. Video diagram is secondary to typography, no UI labels, names or actual chat content. The complete fullscreen perimeter encompasses both video and chat. No additional frame or container.

Exactly THREE text elements, these exact terms each ONCE: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". No other words, numbers, watermark, logos, badges or slogan. Do not split Fullscreen. All text remains comfortably readable at220x140, within an8% safe margin on all four canvas edges. No cropped letters or overlap between any text and diagram. No people, photos, gaming, landscape, scenes, browser chrome or dashboard.

revisions.purpose: Correct panoramic first output to compact 11:7 canvas and inset chat geometry
revisions.prompt:
Recompose this exact typographic design for a DIFFERENT CANVAS ASPECT RATIO: target width1760px and height1120px, an11:7 compact landscape rectangle, NOT the current panoramic strip. This aspect ratio is mandatory. Reposition and proportionally scale its existing elements to use the taller canvas, preserving the refined thin regular/medium Swiss sans letterforms, pure black background, crisp white lettering and one red hairline. Do NOT simply stretch the existing artwork, crop it or add blank letterboxing.

Keep exactly these existing words, once each, unchanged: YouTube, Fullscreen, Live Chat. Preserve the asymmetric hierarchy and normal-width REGULAR white font, not heavy bold. YouTube near upper-left, Fullscreen through the upper-middle, the small video diagram toward lower-left, Live Chat lower-right. Make every word readable at220px image width, with8% text safe margins. The whole design must fit the requested compact rectangle without cut-off text. No additions or duplicated copy.

Keep the existing small abstract video/play/chat diagram. Correct its chat to be a small inset rectangular overlay INSIDE the complete video rather than sharing the video perimeter: show a clear gap between chat pane and every side of outer fullscreen boundary. White fine strokes and red play triangle. All geometry remains FLAT and secondary to typography. Preserve thinness and careful spacing. No photo, landscape, texture, 3D material, shadows, bevel, gradient, glow, extra labels, numbers or watermark.

verification.requiredWords: Exact three terms each once, no additional visible copy.
verification.composition: Chat inset inside complete video; no overlapping or cropped words.
